effect.shortEffect: When hit by a wind move, the power of the next Electric-type move it uses is doubled.
effect.full: The Pokémon becomes charged when it is hit by a wind move, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

french.sv: Si le Pokémon est touché par une capacité faisant appel\nau vent, il se charge en électricité.

english.sv: The Pokémon becomes charged when it is hit by a wind move, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

japanese.sv: 風技を　受けると じゅうでん　状態に　なる。
